1: // Nebula Runner – simple endless runner
2: // Target canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8: 
9:   // size canvas to fill window
10:   const resize = () => {
11:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
12:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
13:   };
14:   resize();
15:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
16: 
17:   // Ship definition
18:   const ship = {
19:     x: canvas.width * 0.1,
20:     y: canvas.height / 2,
21:     w: 30,
22:     h: 20,
23:     speed: 4,
24:     color: '#0ff',
25:   };
26: 
27:   // Input handling
28:   const keys = {};
29:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
30:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
31: 
32:   // Asteroid pool
33:   const asteroids = [];
34:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
35:   let lastSpawn = 0;
36: 
37:   const random = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
38: 
39:   function spawnAsteroid() {
40:     const size = random(20, 50);
41:     asteroids.push({
42:       x: canvas.width + size,
43:       y: random(0, canvas.height - size),
44:       w: size,
45:       h: size,
46:       speed: random(2, 6),
47:       color: '#888',
48:     });
49:   }
50: 
51:   // Collision detection (AABB)
52:   function collides(a, b) {
53:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
54:   }
55: 
56:   let gameOver = false;
57:   let score = 0;
58:   let lastTime = 0;
59: 
60:   function update(dt) {
61:     // ship movement
62:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
63:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
64:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
65:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
66:     // keep inside bounds
67:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w, ship.x));
68:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.h, ship.y));
69: 
70:     // spawn asteroids
71:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
72:       spawnAsteroid();
73:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
74:     }
75: 
76:     // update asteroids
77:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
78:       const a = asteroids[i];
79:       a.x -= a.speed;
80:       if (a.x + a.w < 0) {
81:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
82:         score++;
83:         continue;
84:       }
85:       if (collides(ship, a)) {
86:         gameOver = true;
87:       }
88:     }
89:   }
90: 
91:   function draw() {
92:     // clear
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
94:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
95: 
96:     // draw ship (triangle)
97:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
98:     ctx.beginPath();
99:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
100:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
101:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
102:     ctx.closePath();
103:     ctx.fill();
104: 
105:     // draw asteroids
106:     for (const a of asteroids) {
107:       ctx.fillStyle = a.color;
108:       ctx.beginPath();
109:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
110:       ctx.fill();
111:     }
112: 
113:     // UI
114:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
115:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
116:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
117:     if (gameOver) {
118:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
119:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
120:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
121:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
122:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
123:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
124:     }
125:   }
126: 
127:   function loop(timestamp) {
128:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
129:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
130:     lastTime = timestamp;
131: 
132:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
133:     draw();
134:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
135:   }
136: 
137:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
138: })();
